run_ultrafeedback_dataset_pipeline: run the ultrafeedback script to convert UltraFeedback dataset into unpaired preference format for alignment
create_ScriptArguments_dataclass: create ScriptArguments dataclass with model_name, aspect, push_to_hub, repo_id, and dataset_num_proc fields
run_to_unpaired_preference: run to_unpaired_preference to transform UltraFeedback examples into prompt-completion-label pairs for a given model and aspect
run_dataset_filter_transform_split: run dataset filter, map, and train_test_split to prepare UltraFeedback data for fine-tuning
push_to_huggingface_hub: push the processed dataset and model card to a Hugging Face Hub repository
